overall_reason: The page is built around its own product: an interactive before/after specimen that labels the tells it removes, a live detector toggle over real slop specimens, a command fader board and a real agent transcript; the condensed display face and yellow annotation tags are a chosen system. Weak spots are a stock testimonial wall and some generic section heads.

findings.where: testimonial marquee under the hero, 1440 tiles 00-01
findings.evidence: 31 tweet cards (each duplicated for the loop) of near-identical praise: 'It's so good.', 'Impeccable is so so good. I love it.', 'This is the best plugin ever created imo.', 'How is this free?? 🔥🔥'. Attributed with real handles and avatars, so not invented, but T-DELETION: removing 25 of them loses nothing, and the wall pushes the page to 2,436 words.
findings.before: 31-card horizontal testimonial wall directly after the hero
findings.after: Keep 3-4 quotes that say what changed ('I owe like 3 customer conversions to you', 'Upgraded an internal tool... reduced AI slop') and link to the rest.
findings.why: A testimonial wall is the stock social-proof section; volume reads as default rather than evidence.

findings.evidence: T-FRESH-READER: 'Built around your project.', 'Respects your design system.', 'Design for the job at hand.' would fit any dev-tool site; contrast with the specific 'Detects and removes AI slop.' and 'Give your design a different starting point.'
findings.after: Head with the mechanism, e.g. 'Reads your tokens, Tailwind config and DESIGN.md before it touches a page.'
findings.why: Generic heads are the one place the page drops into default voice.

findings.evidence: 'Install Impeccable →' paired with a stock text second action 'How it works'.
findings.after: A second action that names something only this product has, e.g. 'Try it on a sample page' (the console already exists below).

findings.where: 'Give your design a different starting point', 1440 tile 06
findings.evidence: Yellow tags '01 · EXPLORE DIRECTIONS' and '02 · SEE ONE BUILT' and the debug line 'roll nxgujtks:0 · pool c3b204a1eed6' read as chrome; the numbering adds nothing to a two-column layout.
findings.after: Drop the numbers and the roll/pool hash from the visible UI.
findings.why: Decorative numbering and exposed debug tokens are small template residues on an otherwise considered page.

strengths: Hero specimen is the product: a before/after slider over a card with yellow tags naming 'AI kicker', 'Italic serif', 'Side-tab border', 'AI beige' and /polish /distill /clarify toggles (T-RIVAL-NAME passes: no competitor could run this hero).

'Detects and removes AI slop.' section with a working 'Detector on' toggle over labelled specimens; the sweep's eyebrow, side_tab_border, gradient, nested_cards, neon_violet, default_names and chrome_glyphs hits sit on these deliberate specimens and the sample 'Invite your team' / hotel demo, not on the page's own design.
Distinct type voice (condensed Alumni Sans display, JetBrains Mono for commands) used consistently; real agent transcript and DESIGN.md / PRODUCT.md examples.
Footer is short and specific (Created by Paul Bakaus), not a link farm.
not_investigated: Explore-directions thumbnails render as blank grey in tiles 1440-06 although dom reports the images complete; likely a fade-in not triggered by capture, not judged as design.
